categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes the HTTP REST server handling for getutxos in src/rest.cpp and has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug causing `/rest/getutxos` POST requests to fail silently to return existing UTXOs due to request body deserialization misalignment. Correctness of data returned across programmatic interfaces is a primary priority in this category.
